'''Tokursh''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="ImpCom" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The area was rich in [[Mining/Legends|unmined]] [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], a fact that caught the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon after its [[Declaration of a New Order|foundation]]. The Imperial government offered the Mandalorian clans and the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company a contract worth eight million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the exclusive rights to mine the Tokursh region.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tokursh region first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].

Tokursh's name appears to be derived from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]], specifically the word ''to'kursh'', meaning "orchard".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
